name: Bosch
verdict: Robert Bosch GmbH is 94% owned by the not-for-profit Robert Bosch Stiftung. Nothing found.
note: Series partner (fiawec.com partners page, fetched 2026-09-26). Also Official Partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to bosch-pt.co.uk/professional, stands under 'Official Partners' with the line 'Professional power tools' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): Robert Bosch GmbH is about 94% owned by the not-for-profit Robert Bosch Stiftung GmbH, with about 5% held by a Bosch family company (bosch-stiftung-ownership). No state or state-fund shareholder.
